verdict.rationale: In-product AI insights are a fair question for a payments and commerce platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers enabling third-party shopping agents (ACP/UCP checkout, product feeds, tokenization) and an MCP server for querying data through an external LLM client. Neither is AI-generated insight or suggestion delivered inside the product: the MCP server is a developer building block used from outside, so it earns no credit.
